note_text: FINAL PATHOLOGY: Papillary thyroid carcinoma, classical type. Primary tumor 1.2 cm. Lymph nodes 0 of 3 positive. Margins negative for carcinoma.
THYROID US: Right lobe solid hypoechoic nodule measuring 1.1 cm with microcalcifications. TI-RADS category 5 assigned.
Laboratory review. TSH 0.45 mIU/L. Free T4 1.0 ng/dL. Specimen for thyroglobulin collected on 2019-10-02; result reported 2019-10-05. Thyroglobulin below assay sensitivity.
Oncology surveillance visit. Patient alive without structural evidence of disease at thirty-six months after initial therapy. Continue routine follow-up.
OPERATIVE NOTE: Thyroidectomy performed. Tumor closely applied to tracheal cartilage without full-thickness airway invasion. Trachea intact.
Labs today: TSH 2.5 mIU/L. No other abnormalities.
